chapter_seo_title: Dao Gui Yi Xian Ch. 230: Li Huowang’s Descent & The Black Tai Sui’s Return
chapter_meta_description: Li Huowang suffers a violent psychotic break, grounding himself through horrific self-mutilation, only for a familiar parasitic horror to reappear.
og_description: Li Huowang’s cry of pain challenges the very concept of reality.
twitter_title: Li Huowang’s own finger becomes a reality check
twitter_description: A broken man cuts off his finger to feel real, just as a real monster finds him.

lore_anchors.definition: A grotesque parasitic entity produced by twisted cultivation. The traditional *Tai Sui* is a revered folk spirit, but here it is inverted into a living, flesh-eating substance.
A gentle, nurturing female protagonist who serves as Li Huowang’s emotional anchor in the Dao-Twisted World. She is a *chu ma* spirit medium.
A location in the Dao-Twisted World, likely a frontier or nomadic region with different customs and a distinct visual aesthetic.
